items.text: October is #BreastCancerAwarenessMonth & today, I joined my colleagues from both sides of the aisle to advocate for more resources, support for prevention, and treatment. Breast cancer is detectable and treatable, but sadly in Hawaiʻi, we lose 155 women each year to this disease. https://t.co/NQ46Y5RIAF
We have made incredible progress but must do more to save lives and increase access to testing and treatment for all women.

Mahalo to @SecBecerra for attending our Bipartisan Rural Health Caucus meeting to kick off Nat'l Rural Health Month & discuss how HHS & Congress can work together to support patients & providers in rural America. Mahalo to all my colleagues who participated! #RuralHealthMatters https://t.co/ere6Cu2jIG

DEADLINE: Hawaii Residents seeking affordable health care coverage in 2024 have until next Tuesday, Jan. 16, 2024 to #getcovered and sign up for a plan at https://t.co/zkJ4aePwH7!  Need help? Call my office at (808) 746-6220. https://t.co/qA3TYyZwfo

Fly-in weeks means there a lot of Hawaii people in DC! Yesterday was great to see our @IAFFofficial Fire Fighters, our American College of OB/GYN members, Hawaii's Child Nutrition Program & my friends at @elementalexcel. #JillontheJob https://t.co/XcT6UIIABU

Seats for medical personnel & for patients must be a priority. Making it to funerals, students accessing educational opportunities & competitions & police transports to court. This is an every day struggle on Moloka‘i & it is not acceptable.

The Affordable Care Act is under attack, threatening the healthcare coverage of 45M people including more than 64k in Hawaii. W/out the ACA, preventive care will no longer be free & seniors will pay more for drugs. We cannot let this happen which is why I'm proud to #ProtectACA! https://t.co/VBaTq7yC5U

Lots of great work in #Maui today speaking w/local health orgs on mental health support for fire survivors, meeting w/impacted businesses to discuss their needs, & touring Lahaina w/community leaders on how my Lahaina National Heritage Area Act can support their recovery efforts! https://t.co/jR6Z7gQdko

Excited @USDANutrition will seek to update the Thrifty Food Plan, which calculates nutrition benefits, for Hawai'i: https://t.co/Moy2Unb6LI.

Ensuring this calculation reflects the cost of food throughout Hawaii is critical. I will continue to work with USDA to keep families fed.

Increasing our healthcare workforce is critical so we can better serve our 'ohana in rural and remote communities.🩺

Mahalo to @uhmedjabsom leadership and current JABSOM students for attending today's #RuralHealthTalkStory on how we can continue to support workforce development. https://t.co/V1WX6KcJro

Excited @USDA is awarding over $245,000 in Farm to School grants to Hawaiʻi! Farm to School grants provide opportunities for our keiki to learn about nutrition & agriculture and provides pathways to nutrition security. To learn more about the grants: https://t.co/9r7fx1cdQi https://t.co/ai3ob951HQ

Our communities face unique challenges accessing mental health services due to stigma, limited culturally appropriate services, and lack of data in research. Beyond #MinorityMentalHealthMonth, we must address these impacts & act to eliminate health disparities and inequities. https://t.co/lIinDFpkqc

Today, Iowa became the latest state to attack women's healthcare by implementing a ban on abortions after six weeks. We must stop GOP extremist attacks on abortion & IVF. Proud to join @ProChoiceCaucus for #ReproductiveFreedomWeekofAction 
because our fight is far from over.🧵 https://t.co/uVwk4hyn1T

Medicare & Medicaid turn 59 today! 

This landmark law allows hundreds of thousands of keiki and kupuna in Hawai'i to access quality, affordable healthcare. I am committed to ensuring  healthcare remains a right for everyone in our communities & across the country. https://t.co/3suze43Bi1

Honored to speak at @HI_PacificAHEC @uhmedjabsom Hawai'i Health Workforce Summit to discuss supporting Maui, reimbursements that reflect our cost of care & retaining our healthcare workers. Mahalo to our medical professionals who support a healthier future for our ‘ohana. ❤️ https://t.co/j1P4w8aiLi

I testified before House Veterans' Affairs about my Parity for Native Hawaiian Veterans Act, to improve healthcare access and affordability for our Native Hawaiian veterans. I will continue fighting for fair and equal treatment and honor the sacrifice of all our veterans. https://t.co/a8yAxDM6ST

I’m excited to share that @waimanalohealth is receiving $600,000 to expand their behavioral & mental health services! Big mahalo to @HRSAgov for supporting WHC & the dedicated health care workers who make a real difference in our communities. https://t.co/ekS5FUp6tv

Your reminder that extremist Republicans want to:

❌ Raise taxes
❌ Cut Medicaid & Social Security
❌ Eliminate Head Start for 3,000 keiki in Hawaii

Project 2025 hurts our hard working ʻohana. I will keep fighting to ensure these policies never see the light of day. https://t.co/wzuQD0Ox7F

Honored to support MauiWES & speak at their Wellness Fest this weekend. We need a comprehensive study & registry to identify wildfire impacts & provide supportive services for generations to come.

Big mahalo to HFC, NIH, & Kaiser for sponsoring this event & supporting Maui! https://t.co/L3lE39SSJy

October is #BreastCancerAwarenessMonth. This month is a reminder to get annual screenings, support research, & honor survivors. I stand with our ʻohana who fight against this illness & will keep advocating for equitable health care for all. 💗 https://t.co/oJcxQB931V

Happy to speak at Community First's Hawai‘i Healthcare Conference & discuss our work in Congress to increase access to health care. Also ran into @HMHBHawaii & checked out their mobile health clinic. Mahalo for your work with our mothers & babies, & showing me Big Mama! 🚐 https://t.co/oVt7OABu4N

More from my recent trip to Kauaʻi: Visited Kauaʻi Community College to see their health workforce development programs, talk with @YWCAofKAUAI and their Abortion Access Workgroup on challenges, & sat down with @kauaipd on safe firearm disposal for seized weapons. Mahalo! https://t.co/ZRVMdtPIGV

It's #RuralHealthMonth, and as co-chair of the Bipartisan Rural Health Caucus & a proud representative of rural communities, I believe your zipcode should not determine whether you have access to quality health care. Stay tuned for updates on rural health throughout November! https://t.co/jPkUzIksgI

Proud to stand in solidarity with our nurses on Maui fighting for safer staffing, fair wages, & the ability to better care for our community. Our nurses are putting patients and the needs of their families first—they take care of us, so let’s take care of them! https://t.co/yQjS2jGJ2e

RFK Jr. and President-Elect Trump have committed to an extreme agenda that promises to hamstring our federal health agencies and their essential work to keep Americans safe. Cutting critical investments is not making America healthy again—it's reckless, and leaving us unprepared. https://t.co/fObqtBqKXk
